design_conventions.difficulty: 1-5 級設計參數，非官方數據。
design_conventions.estimated_hours: 設計參數，按課題學習成果數量估算，非官方數據。
design_conventions.completion_threshold: 設計門檻，以無提示達成率 ≥80% 為準；非官方評分標準。
design_conventions.marking_criteria: 在缺官方 Marking Scheme 下，由 Guide 的 'Students should be able to' 學習成果逐點提煉，屬考評對應期望，非評分方案原文。
design_conventions.prerequisites: 按課程順序的設計判斷，官方文件未明列前置關係。
design_conventions.weight_null: null 表示官方未公佈該層級佔分，屬【資料缺口】，不得以估算值填補。

nodes.title: DSE Chemistry 達 5** 總目標
marking_criteria: AO1 recall and show understanding of chemical facts, patterns, principles, terminology and conventions
AO2 show an understanding of the use of apparatus and materials in performing experiments
AO3 handle materials, manipulate apparatus, carry out experiments safely and make accurate observations
AO4 demonstrate an understanding of the method used in chemical investigation
AO5 analyse and interpret data from various sources, and draw relevant conclusions
AO6 manipulate and translate chemical data and perform calculations
AO7 apply chemical knowledge to explain observations and solve problems which may involve unfamiliar situations
AO8 select and organise scientific information and communicate it in an appropriate and logical manner
AO9 understand and evaluate the social, economic, environmental and technological implications of the applications of chemistry
AO10 make decisions based on the examination of evidence and arguments
nodes.completion_threshold: Paper 1 (60%)、Paper 2 (20%)、SBA (20%) 三模塊全部達標，且全科加權總分達 5** 級界線。界線數值未公佈【資料缺口】；2024 年 5** 佔全體考生 2.6%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.5）。
nodes.source: SRC-AF p.1-2（Assessment Objectives 及 Mode of Assessment）；SRC-BRIEF24 p.5
nodes.notes: 根節點。整體達標門檻以等級界線表達，官方不公佈界線數值，故只保留百分位參考。

nodes.title: Paper 1 必修部分
marking_criteria: Paper 1 佔全科 60%
Section A 多項選擇題佔全科 18%
Section B 短題、結構題及論述題佔全科 42%
Section A 與 B 的 Part I 主要考 Topics I-VIII，Part II 主要考 Topics IX-XII
考生須作答全卷所有題目
nodes.completion_threshold: 兩節合計折算達全科加權 60% 內之目標分數，且 Topics I-XII 全部課題節點達標。
nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2（PUBLIC EXAMINATION）
nodes.notes: Section A/B 為題型分割而非內容分割，故不另設一級分支，避免同一課題在兩處重複計分。課題層佔分官方未公佈【資料缺口】。

nodes.title: Topic I 地球行星
marking_criteria: describe the processes involved in fractional distillation of liquid air
evaluate the appropriateness of evaporation, distillation, crystallisation and filtration for different separation situations
demonstrate flame test, test for chloride, test for water and test for carbon dioxide
use word equations to describe chemical changes
nodes.completion_threshold: 無提示下完成上述 4 項，並能為 3 組指定混合物選定分離法且說明理據；計時練習 ≥80%。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic I, p. I-1–I-3
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分；本節點屬 Paper 1 Part I 範圍。

nodes.title: Topic II 微觀世界 I
marking_criteria: deduce electronic arrangements of atoms up to Z=20 and relate position in the Periodic Table to electronic structure
describe the formation of ions and ionic bonds using electron diagrams
relate the properties of metals, giant ionic, simple molecular and giant covalent substances to their structures
perform calculations related to chemical formulae and relative molecular masses
nodes.completion_threshold: 無提示下為 Z≤20 元素寫電子排布並推 group/period；用電子圖描述 NaCl 與 CO2 鍵合；由結構解釋四類物質熔點與導電性差異。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic II, p. I-4–I-9
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。本節點為 Topic III 及 Topic VI 的共同前置。

nodes.title: Topic III 金屬
marking_criteria: transcribe word equations into chemical equations
perform calculations involving the mole and chemical equations
establish a reactivity series of metals based on experimental evidence
describe methods for the extraction of metals from their ores
explain the factors leading to corrosion and methods to prevent it
nodes.completion_threshold: mass↔mole↔粒子數 互換 5 題全對；以離子方程式寫 3 個置換反應並用 reactivity series 排序；提出 2 種防鏽方法及理據。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic III, p. I-10–I-14
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。mole 概念在此引入，是全科定量題的唯一入口。

nodes.title: Topic IV 酸與鹼
marking_criteria: use an instrumental method of pH measurement
prepare salts by different methods
perform volumetric analysis involving acids and alkalis
apply the concepts of concentration of solution and titration results to solve stoichiometric problems
solve problems involving back titration with sufficient information given
nodes.completion_threshold: 由 titration 數據算未知濃度（含 1 題資料齊備的 back titration）；為 3 組指定鹽各選可行製備路徑並排除不可行組合；滴定三次讀數相差 ≤0.10 cm³。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic IV, p. I-15–I-19；Part II note IV(f), p. II-3
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。back titration 只在題目提供足夠資料時要求。

nodes.title: Topic V 化石燃料與碳化合物
marking_criteria: give systematic names of alkanes, alkenes, alkanols and alkanoic acids with carbon chains not more than eight carbon atoms
describe the chemical reactions of alkanes and alkenes
explain the formation of addition polymers and relate uses to structures and properties
describe the monosubstitution of methane with chlorine using suitable diagrams or equations
nodes.completion_threshold: C1–C8 烷烴系統命名與結構式全對；由加成聚合物推單體與重複單位；以同系物趨勢解釋沸點變化。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic V, p. I-20–I-24；Part II notes V(b)-(d), p. II-4
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。單一官能基的優先次序不要求；苯的穩定性不要求解釋。

nodes.title: Topic VI 微觀世界 II
marking_criteria: explain the polar nature of molecules with reference to electronegativity, polarity of bonds and molecular shape
differentiate van der Waals' forces in non-polar and polar covalent substances
predict and draw three-dimensional diagrams of shapes of simple molecules
explain the properties of molecular crystals such as ice and C60 in terms of their structures
nodes.completion_threshold: 判斷 3 個分子的形狀與極性；由分子間力排序 3 種物質沸點；解釋冰與 C60 的性質差異。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VI, p. I-25–I-27；Part II notes VI(a)-(e), p. II-4–II-5
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。不要求 dipole moment 數值、不要求背電負性標度、不要求鍵角。

nodes.title: Topic VII 氧化還原、化學電池與電解
marking_criteria: carry out investigations involving common oxidising and reducing agents
write chemical equations for redox reactions
predict the feasibility of a redox reaction by comparing positions in the electrochemical series
predict products in electrolysis according to factors affecting preferential discharge of ions
nodes.completion_threshold: 由氧化數變化指認氧化劑與還原劑；配平 2 條離子方程式；由 ECS 預測電池方向與電解產物。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VII, p. I-28–I-32；Part II notes VII(a),(d), p. II-5
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。不要求描述六種電池的結構與工作原理。

nodes.title: Topic VIII 化學反應與能量
marking_criteria: explain energy changes in chemical reactions in terms of the conservation of energy
recognise enthalpy change as heat change at constant pressure
carry out experimental determination of enthalpy changes using a simple calorimetric method
apply Hess's law to calculate enthalpy changes
nodes.completion_threshold: 由 calorimetry 數據算 ΔH（含熱容量修正）；用 Hess's law 由 2 條已知方程式推目標 ΔH，符號與方向正確。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VIII, p. I-33–I-34；Part II notes VIII(a),(b), p. II-5
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。不要求炸彈量熱計原理、不要求推導 ΔH 與恆壓熱變的關係。

nodes.title: Topic IX 反應速率
marking_criteria: select and justify techniques to follow the progress of a reaction (titrimetric analysis, volume or pressure change, mass change, colour intensity)
explain qualitatively the effects of concentration, surface area and temperature on rate of reaction
appreciate the importance of catalysts in chemical industries and biological systems
nodes.completion_threshold: 為 2 個指定反應各選一種監測方法並說明理由；用 3 個因素預測速率變化；區分速率改變與平衡位置改變。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic IX, p. I-35–I-38；Part II notes IX(a),(b), p. II-5
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。Maxwell-Boltzmann 分佈屬 Topic XIII 範圍；不要求各監測技術的計算與儀器細節。

nodes.title: Topic X 化學平衡
marking_criteria: appreciate the dynamic nature of chemical equilibrium
understand the equilibrium constant Kc and its mathematical treatment in relation to stoichiometry
predict qualitatively the effect of changes in concentration and temperature on the position of equilibrium in a homogeneous reaction
use the reaction quotient to deduce the effect of change in concentration on equilibrium position
nodes.completion_threshold: 寫出 Kc 表達式；由平衡濃度算 Kc；由 Q 與 Kc 比較判斷移動方向；用 ΔH 符號預測溫度效應。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic X, p. I-39–I-41；Part II note X(c), p. II-6
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。不要求推導 lnK 與 ΔH/RT 關係；不要求非反應物種引入的效應；不要求涉及 redox 與 acid-base 的平衡細節。

nodes.title: Topic XI 碳化合物化學
marking_criteria: give systematic names, general formulae, condensed formulae and structural formulae for alkanes, alkenes, haloalkanes, alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, esters, unsubstituted amides and primary amines
recognise structural isomerism, cis-trans isomerism and enantiomerism
describe reactions of functional groups in terms of reagents, conditions, products and observations
use chemical methods to distinguish functional groups and identify unknown carbon compounds
nodes.completion_threshold: C≤8 九類官能基命名全對；寫出 4 類官能基的反應（試劑、條件、觀察）；以化學測試區分 3 組指定化合物。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XI, p. I-42–I-47；Part II notes XI(a)-(c), p. II-6–II-7
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。不要求多官能基優先次序、不要求 polarimetry 與 racemic mixture 細節。

nodes.title: Topic XII 化學世界的規律
marking_criteria: describe the periodic variation in physical properties of the elements from Li to Ar
relate the periodic relationship between acid-base properties of selected oxides
describe the properties of selected transition metals and their compounds
nodes.completion_threshold: 由 Li 至 Ar 解釋熔點與導電性的週期變化；以氧化物酸鹼性排序 3 個指定氧化物；舉 2 個過渡金屬的工業用途。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XII, p. I-48–I-50
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】官方未公佈課題層佔分。本節點為整合型課題，前置依賴跨多個課題。

nodes.title: Paper 2 選修部分
marking_criteria: Paper 2 佔全科 20%
由結構題組成，考生須作答所選 2 個選修單元的題目
每個選修單元平均佔 10%（20% ÷ 2，屬算術推算）
nodes.completion_threshold: 兩個選修單元節點全部達標，且限時 Paper 2 模擬卷兩選修各達目標分數。
nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2（Paper 2, 20%, 1 hour）
nodes.notes: 三選二無法以 AND 前置表達，屬 schema 表達力限制【結構限制】。選修單元節點權重 10% 為算術推算，非官方逐單元公佈值。

nodes.title: Topic XIII 工業化學
marking_criteria: discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using industrial processes from social, economic and environmental perspectives
determine the rate equation of a reaction by the method of initial rate
calculate the atom economy of a chemical reaction
evaluate industrial processes using the principles of green chemistry
nodes.completion_threshold: 給一張未見流程圖：指出各單元操作目的；就 2 個操作條件提出改變並以 equilibrium/rate/成本三軸解釋；計算 atom economy；指出 1 個環境風險點及處理。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XIII, p. I-51–I-55；Part II notes XIII(a),(b),(f), p. II-8
nodes.notes: 不要求 contact process、維他命 C、醋酸製造的流程細節；不要求 half-life。2024 年修讀率 98%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.8）。

nodes.title: Topic XIV 材料化學
marking_criteria: describe the chemical structures and different phases of organic liquid crystals
identify the structural features of substances that exhibit liquid-crystalline behaviour
relate the uses of liquid crystals to their properties
nodes.completion_threshold: 由結構判斷 3 種物質是否具液晶行為；由結構解釋 2 個液晶應用；區分四類固體結構與性質。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XIV, p. I-56–I-60；Part II note XIV(d), p. II-8
nodes.notes: 不要求背液晶物質的分子式。2024 年修讀率 6%、Paper 2 折算平均 37.6%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.8），屬自選群體數據。

nodes.title: Topic XV 分析化學
marking_criteria: gather data with appropriate instruments and apparatus in quantitative analysis
record observations and data accurately and systematically
be aware of and take necessary steps to minimise possible sources of error
perform calculations on data obtained to draw evidence-based conclusions
justify the choice of an appropriate quantitative method
assess possible risks associated with quantitative analysis
nodes.completion_threshold: 由 IR/NMR/MS 圖譜指認 3 個未知物；由滴定或比色數據算濃度；為指定樣本選分離與檢測方法並說明理據、誤差來源與風險。
nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XV, p. I-61–I-65；Part II note XV(c), p. II-9
nodes.notes: 不要求前課題以外的新化學流程細節。2024 年修讀率 96%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.8）。

nodes.title: SBA 校本評核
marking_criteria: SBA 佔全科 20%，所有學校考生必修
S5 與 S6 各佔 10%
兩年內至少 1 次 Volumetric Analysis、1 次 Qualitative Analysis、2 次 Other Experiments
Investigative Study 可代替 Other Experiments（1 次 proposal + 1 次 process and report）
nodes.completion_threshold: 完成最低評核次數，且三類評核均達校內評分標準。
nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2-3（SBA 及其評核次數與權重表）
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】SBA Handbook 未提供，具體評分準則未取得。2024 年 SBA 平均 74.1%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.9）。

nodes.title: 實驗技能與探究
marking_criteria: designing experiments
reporting and interpreting experimental results
practical skills, process skills and reporting skills demonstrated through investigative study
nodes.completion_threshold: 完成 1 次 VA、1 次 QA、2 次 EXPT；記錄表含單位與不確定度；就 1 個誤差來源提出可執行改良。
nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2-3；SBA Handbook（未提供）
nodes.notes: 【資料缺口】SBA 評分準則細節在 SBA Handbook，未取得；本節點權重併入 CHEM-SBA 的 20%。
